query: UPDATE vpn_client_mfa_session SET steps_snapshot = CASE WHEN ephemeral_state IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_set( steps_snapshot, ARRAY['steps', current_step::text, 'satisfied'], ephemeral_state->'selected_method' ) ELSE steps_snapshot END, ephemeral_state = NULL, current_step = current_step + 1, failed_attempts = 0 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING current_step
